video._rule: Cost law v7.4 (Nipam, 15 Sep 2026): EVERY video shot → seedance_fast_crun (Crun bytedance/seedance2-0-fast-r2v, 480p, $0.043/s, 132 cr per 15 s). No viggle, no protoface, no vgenv, no fal, no Atlas unless Nipam says so. Identity = look portrait(s) + set + last-frame ref (≤9 refs). Per-clip QC (tile + whisper) stays; retakes on the same lane with a fixed prompt. Images stay ₹0 on the unlimited MCPs. Finals: 480p native → post upscale to 1080p (ffmpeg lanczos) until a ₹0 upscaler is wired.
video._drama_rule: v7.4: drama = Mode C (dialogue, ≤3 shots per ≤15 s clip) + Mode B (action/establishers, keyframe as an extra reference, never as start frame) on Crun Seedance FAST; Mode A = fast-i2v start frame only when p1/p3 match. Costume risk: Seedance may strip/alter clothing on intimate or physical prompts → keep 'clothes stay on, same outfit' in every prompt and QC every clip; retake with a stronger costume line. Hindi dialogue is weaker on Seedance (3/7 EP4) → write Hindi lines in Devanagari + Roman, keep them short, expect retakes.

viggle_h3.inputs: prompt + quality(low|high) + duration_s 3–15 + resolution 480p|768p|1080p + aspect_ratio; reference_image ×4 (mode B) XOR first_frame_image(+last_frame_image) (mode A); poll GET /v1/videos/{id} → status ready + video_url (short-lived)
viggle_h3.runner: tools/run_viggle.py <proj> <manifest> [ids] — PC ONLY (Cloudflare blocks the cloud container); key in .config/keys_viggle.env on the PC
viggle_h3.notes: A/B vs protoface on EP3 003-03: high = same identity/framing/no cut, line verbatim, $0.05 vs 18 cr ($0.18). low = garbled dialogue → drafts only. ~2.5 min/clip. FULL EP3 3-way (14 Sep): high 16/16 identity, 0 cuts, 7/9 lines verbatim (one number 2019→2018, one dropped word); low 2/9 lines. Rule: viggle high default → whisper QC → failed lines retake on protoface. Gotchas: reference mode needs duration_s ≥ 5 (4 s = instant TASK_FAILED, retryable=true but deterministic); mode A accepts 4 s; ~16 parallel OK (episode in 12 min); Windows launch: set env via $env: not `set X=.. &&` (trailing space); refs must exist on the PC. Overnight-17 (15 Sep): 60+ clips, 0 in-clip cuts except 1 two-location action shot; EN lines 30/30 verbatim; 1080p same price; ar must be passed (16:9) per manifest item; PC background runners must be launched from Windows (device-VM procs die).
viggle_h3.limits: refs: at most 4 reference images (video+image combined cap 4), 1 ref video, no ref audio; duration 3–15 s (ref mode ≥5); 480p/768p/1080p same price
viggle_h3.role: v7.4 DISABLED by Nipam — Crun Seedance FAST is the only video lane. Re-enable only on his explicit word (emergency: Crun down).

_category_lanes.ecommerce_ad_15s: Flow product card (multi-view) + model chip + set card → 3 keyframes (hero / in-use / pack) → viggle high 9:16 ≥5 s each → whisper QC → assemble with VO line. 15 s ≈ $0.15. Product text must be on the card; never invent text in video.
_category_lanes.brand_tvc_30s: 16:9! pass ar in the manifest. 6 × 5 s mode B, camera moves allowed (push-in/arc/crane) in one take; product card + set card + character. Hero shots → protoface 2K only if broadcast. ≈ $0.30.
_category_lanes.ugc_creator_20s: 1 creator chip + product card, 3 shots (hook 5 / demo 8 / CTA 7), product in hand in every keyframe. Lines ≤ 14 words. ≈ $0.20.
_category_lanes.action: mode A 3-panel masters with coordinate layer (subject_box start→end, event_box, speed_curve). Keep ONE location per clip; a two-location travel (cab → doorway) cuts at ~5 s → split into two shots.
_category_lanes.two_speaker_shot: both chips + both @Image refs, alternating lines ≤ 8 words, 8 s, mode B — works (8/8 lines).
_category_lanes.emotion_night: mode B with practical/neon light stated; identity holds; 6 s.
_category_lanes.crowd: state 'extras all different faces' in keyframe + H3 群演禁止一模一样; lead chip; works.
_category_lanes.continuation_chain: clip A last frame (-0.15 s) = clip B first_frame; chain ≤ 3 then fresh keyframe.
_category_lanes.costume: COSTUME LOCK: every keyframe prompt carries the exact wardrobe line (+ 'no <previous garment>'); for multi-shot scenes generate a WARDROBE CARD (front/back on white) and attach by tile title — t14 failed without it (4 dresses in 6 shots).
_category_lanes.trailer_60s: title beat (text in post) + montage 15 s (protoface ref-to-video: 3 chars + set + 12-panel storyboard @Image5, 54 cr) + dialogue beats (viggle) + end card + BGM (Suno instrumental) at -12 dB.
_category_lanes.animation: stylized 3D: character SHEET (3-view, white) → Flow create_character from the sheet → keyframes with chips + stylized set card; H3 【画面风格】 = stylized 3D render, no photoreal.
_category_lanes.music_video: Suno song first (custom mode, lyrics) → 5 × 6 s mode B, lyric line in the dialogue slot 'sings (…, in tempo)' → cut A: song over; cut B: native singing for lip-sync.
_category_lanes.dubbing: regenerate the shot with the same refs + translated line + accent tag (EN/ES verified verbatim) — better than TTS overdub (lips match).
_category_lanes.resolution: viggle 1080p costs the same as 768p → default finals at 1080p; 2K protoface (13 cr/s) only for hero/broadcast; upscale lane optional.
_category_lanes.voice: H3 voice signature gives 'same actor' feel, not bit-identical; voice-clone (Higgsfield) costs credits → skipped; BGM via Suno instrumental 30 s cues.
